EmailTemplate.subject: ✈️ Travel Survey Results ✈ When is travel bouncing back?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Join us on Wednesday, May 12 at 12 PM ET for an informative webinar, "Set to Soar: How Consumer Travel Plans Point to a Tourism Boom <[[https://more.flywire.com/Webinar_TravelSurvey21.html?utm_source=email1]]>." We'll share the exclusive results of an independent survey of frequent leisure travelers across the globe, as we discuss key findings with a panel of industry professionals. Register today to join us as we answer the following questions:
When are consumers planning to travel again? Where will they visit first? How much will they spend?
Panelists: Dustin Figge, CEO & Founder of Homelike Erling Aspelund, Owner of Iceland Encounter Nicole Murray, Guest Relations Manager at Keefer Lake Lodge
Register
If you can't make the live webinar, please register, and we will share the recording after the broadcast.
